content:
nora_eng: quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring theme = feature-flag promos without server-side limits + sparse validation. want a minimal, low-risk rollout to block worst-case blast radius.
sam_backend: noted. propose server-side hard caps + audit fields. keep defaults conservative to avoid Ops noise.
jon_sre: add automatic region-quorum and replica cap. also require cross-region metrics for global promotes.
maria_p: can we do a shadow mode first? we should measure FP/FN impact before flipping.
tanya_pm: timeline: need exec summary + owners by EOW. keep changes incremental.
sam_backend: plan (small incremental PRs):
- PR-A: server-side config validation + "who_approved" field (3d)
- PR-B: enforce hard cap maxAutoPromotePct=20 unless opt-in override (5d)
- PR-C: regional quorum check for >10% promotes (7d)
- PR-D: shadow-mode rollout + metrics collection (run for 2w)
jon_sre: runbook update: what to do if global promote happened unexpectedly. include immediate suspend + audit + page SRE. I'll update.
maria_p: I'll create synthetic replays and metric scenarios to feed into the shadow run. target to have replays ready before PR-C lands.
nora_eng: owners & dates: PR-A/B sam_backend (start now, PR-A by 2026-04-02), PR-C li_dev+jon_sre (landing by 2026-04-16), PR-D shadow experiment (start 2026-04-06).
tanya_pm: exec ask: include simple KPI: reduction in unexpected global promotes and false rollback rate. keep numbers in follow-up.
deploy-bot: scheduled shadow run #shadow-321 for service=web-gateway at 2026-04-06T08:00Z. results will post here.
sam_backend: small UX note: API will return clear error code when server cap prevents promotion; include link to playbook.
jon_sre: will also add synthetic monitors that detect the "steady creep" pattern described in the postmortem.
maria_p: thanks. will sync with sam on replay params.
nora_eng: good. I'll draft the exec summary and action tracker and share in next 24h. please add blockers here. :thumbsup:
